# midasheng-gen-mcp

Generate coherent 16 kHz mixed audio scenes - speech, music, sound effects,
and ambience in one pass - from structured text captions, powered by
MiDashengLM-Gen (Xiaomi Research, LLM-driven autoregressive flow matching).
Runs locally on CUDA. Apache-2.0.

## Key links

- [README](https://github.com/sandraschi/midasheng-gen-mcp)
- [INSTALL](https://github.com/sandraschi/midasheng-gen-mcp/blob/main/INSTALL.md)
- [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt) - full LLM documentation
- [arXiv 2608.11804](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.11804)
- [Hugging Face model](https://huggingface.co/mispeech/midashenglm-gen)
- [Demo page](https://xingws.github.io/midashenglm-gen-demo/)

## Summary

- MCP tool: `audio_scene` portmanteau (status, generate, list, get, delete,
  export, samples, model lifecycle) + `midasheng_help` + Prefab cards
- Structured caption views: caption, asr, speech, sfx, music, env
- Backend 11159 (REST + MCP /mcp), webapp 11160
- 9 languages, emotion control, variable-length output via learned stop head
